name: Chapter bar
what: A video's chapters as a segmented progress bar along the bottom (or top): it fills as the video plays, the current chapter stands taller and a small '02 · Setup' title pops when each chapter starts. Give it the video's length.
origin: progress bars - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: each fill linear over its chapter; the current segment 2.2x taller (6 f in / out); titles back.out 10 f, away after 45 f
